newsitem.title: USA: Massachusetts insurance head defends department.
newsitem.headline: Massachusetts insurance head defends department.

text.p: Massachusetts Insurance Commissioner Linda Ruthardt defended the state's handling of the conversion of State Mutual Life Assurance, saying policyholders got a fair deal, Boston Globe reported.
Ruthardt told a legislative hearing the agency protected policyholders by playing an "adversarial" role with State Mutual when it converted into the stock-holder owned Allmerica Financial Corp.
"Not a single policyholder has complained," Ruthardt said.
The insurance divison has been accused by state senators and industry watchers of favoring corporate interests over consumer interests and conducting business secretly.
State Sen. Dianne Wilkerson, who convened the hearing, described Ruthardt's decisions as "sporadic, indefensible and inexplicable."
